description: This file manages version resolution for the openclaw project, including reading version info from package.json and build info files, and resolving runtime service versions based on environment variables and module metadata.

methods.name: readVersionFromJsonCandidates
methods.description: Reads version info from a list of JSON files, optionally requiring a specific package name.

methods.name: firstNonEmpty
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty, trimmed string from a list of strings or undefined.

methods.name: readVersionFromPackageJsonForModuleUrl
methods.description: Reads version from package.json files for a given module URL, requiring the package name to be 'openclaw'.

methods.name: readVersionFromBuildInfoForModuleUrl
methods.description: Reads version from build-info.json files for a given module URL.

methods.name: resolveVersionFromModuleUrl
methods.description: Resolves version from package.json or build-info.json for a module URL.

methods.name: resolveBinaryVersion
methods.description: Determines the binary version based on injected, resolved, bundled, or fallback versions.

methods.name: resolveUsableRuntimeVersion
methods.description: Returns a trimmed version string if valid, or undefined if version is '0.0.0' or undefined.

methods.name: resolveVersionFromRuntimeSources
methods.description: Resolves version from environment variables and runtime version, based on preference.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeServiceVersion
methods.description: Resolves the runtime service version, defaulting to 'unknown' if not found.

methods.name: resolveCompatibilityHostVersion
methods.description: Resolves the compatibility host version, considering environment and runtime version.
